prompt: Which player scored 20 goals in the English Premier League in the 2006-2007 season and won 'Chelsea Players Player of the Year' award in 2007?
answer: **Didier Drogba** scored 20 Premier League goals in 2006–07 and won Chelsea’s **Players’ Player of the Year** award in 2007. (Michael Essien won the separate Chelsea Player of the Year award voted for by fans.)
